sourceUse: Official pages were read for IA scope/context. These are varied reviewer inputs, not verified corpus sources or approved RAG answers. Curators must bind exact official full text/revision/section/quote/source keys and reviewers must approve source applicability/reference answers before any admission to canonical gold. Existing 18 seed positives also require review.

sources.scopeNote: Guidance describes decision points for substantial equivalence; a similar device does not alone establish the applicable route.
IVD review considers analytical characteristics. Clinical validity can also need assessment when the analytical-to-clinical link is uncertain.
IVD performance evaluation addresses scientific validity, analytical performance and clinical performance with intended-purpose applicability and justified exceptions.
CTIS is for EU/EEA interventional medicinal-product trials under the CTR, not device-only or observational studies; it does not replace sponsors trial records.
The EU has distinct MDR and IVDR frameworks; device evidence and medicinal-product trial procedures must not be interchanged.
PMDA offers product-specific consultations on development, clinical protocols and submission data packages including regenerative products.
PMDA indexes principles and Q&A on Japanese phase 1 studies before multiregional trials; consult the specific notification rather than assume identical regional implementation.
Clinical evidence supports device licensing and lifecycle decisions; determine device classification and claims before concluding what evidence is sufficient.
IVDD classification is risk-based and evidence is proportional to risk; an erroneous result and its patient-management consequence matter.
Sponsors remain accountable for trial data and participant safety after delegating duties. The overview states E6(R3) was fully adopted April 1, 2026; local regulations can exceed ICH guidance.
Device registration responsibilities differ by domestic/imported status and class; registration and clinical evidence decisions require product-specific assessment.
For drugs marketed overseas, assess existing foreign data for racial sensitivity and PK/PD differences relevant to Chinese benefit and risk.

items.question: We have a wearable arrhythmia detector. A similar FDA-cleared device exists. Can we announce that our device is substantially equivalent?
draftJudgmentTopics: Intended-use and diagnostic claim compared with the proposed predicate
Technology differences and evidence addressing them
mustAvoid: Concluding substantial equivalence from similarity
Calling a submission or comparison an FDA clearance

items.question: We plan a device-only clinical investigation in Germany and France. Should our CRO submit it in CTIS because it is a European trial?
draftJudgmentTopics: Whether any investigational medicinal product is involved if not already excluded
mustAvoid: Routing a device-only investigation through CTIS
Treating Europe as one undifferentiated authority

items.question: We want a Canadian licence for an implant. Our brochure says it works for adults and children, but the study enrolled only adults. Is the evidence enough?
draftJudgmentTopics: Proposed Canadian indication and risk classification
Pediatric bridging or separate evidence supporting the claimed group
mustAvoid: Unqualified pediatric extrapolation
US or EU class silently substituted for Canadian class

items.question: Our overseas manufacturer wants to register a high-risk implant in China using its EU dossier. What is the quickest definite approval route?
draftJudgmentTopics: Chinese classification and intended use
Clinical evaluation and dossier applicability to the imported device
mustAvoid: Guaranteeing approval timing
Treating CE marking as NMPA authorization

items.question: Draft a complete EU performance evaluation conclusion for our diagnostic assay. We have precision and limit-of-detection studies but no patient-level clinical performance data.
draftJudgmentTopics: Intended purpose and scientific validity support
Applicable clinical performance evidence or justified exception
mustAvoid: Treating analytical performance alone as complete clinical evidence
Asserting that every IVD necessarily needs a new prospective trial

items.question: Our serum test has excellent analytical sensitivity. Can we claim 99% clinical sensitivity in symptomatic patients?
draftJudgmentTopics: Clinical accuracy data with reference standard and target population
Specimen and use-setting applicability
mustAvoid: Converting analytical sensitivity to clinical sensitivity
Inventing the 99% result

items.question: Our IVD monitors a drug level. Can we use the lowest Canadian risk class since it only produces a laboratory number?
draftJudgmentTopics: Treatment decisions and harm if a wrong result is used
Intended-use wording and patient population
mustAvoid: Classifying solely because the output is a number
Ignoring imminent harm from wrong patient-management decisions

items.question: Our cell therapy startup wants a guaranteed Japanese conditional approval based on twenty US patients. Can you draft the claim?
draftJudgmentTopics: Product category and intended therapeutic use
Evidence quality, manufacturing consistency and Japan development advice
mustAvoid: Guaranteeing a conditional approval
Turning a small uncontrolled cohort into confirmed efficacy

items.question: We are running an interventional medicinal-product trial in Spain and Italy. Since CTIS holds our application, can we stop maintaining sponsor trial records?
draftJudgmentTopics: Which records and sponsor systems are proposed for retirement
mustAvoid: Treating CTIS as the trial master file or CTMS replacement
Claiming CTIS stores all trial data

items.question: A drug already marketed overseas has a broad safety margin. Does that automatically waive all China applicability analysis?
draftJudgmentTopics: Existing PK/PD and ethnic sensitivity evidence
Target indication and Chinese benefit-risk relevance
mustAvoid: Automatic waiver from a safety-margin label
Treating a claimed margin as a verified quantitative finding

items.question: Our CRO can reuse a US protocol in Japan without changes because it is an ICH trial. Can we approve the plan?
draftJudgmentTopics: Japanese protocol/data-package applicability and local oversight arrangements
Whether the appropriate PMDA development advice has been obtained
mustAvoid: Calling ICH compliance proof of identical implementation
Claiming an unreviewed plan approved

items.question: Our Canadian sponsor delegated monitoring and safety processing to our CRO. Can the sponsor relinquish accountability for participant safety?
draftJudgmentTopics: Exact delegated duties and sponsor oversight arrangements
mustAvoid: Saying delegation removes sponsor accountability
